variant.rationale: The exhaustive optimizer-free V5 audit completed all 11968 cases but failed 7386 required-safety cases, including 6985 hard impacts. Reset-pose diagnosis localized the dominant mechanism to heel-to-forefoot height difference on the lower foot. V6 and V7 all-frame closure removed that defect but collapsed gait contacts, while the V8 support-window corpus validated every clip locally yet missed one required slow-walk cycle in validation and heldout and left hazardous frames whenever provisional support differed from the physically lower sole. This profile preserves the frozen source identities, split assignments, sampling rates, BodySchema, USD, PD and every safety and terminal threshold. It retains the required fifteen-degree ankle-roll hard reserve and the one-degree knee and elbow reserves. Ankle-pitch may use its complete soft ROM down to minus thirty degrees, retaining ten degrees to the hard limit; this is the largest empirically tested pitch reserve that allowed the all-frame closure and subsequent swing recovery to preserve four nominal gait cycles. After deterministic ankle-priority all-frame sole-pitch closure, a four-iteration finite-difference null-space projection raises only the non-support sole toward its pre-closure height while cancelling first-order pitch change. The V10 full-corpus build validated twenty-five of twenty-seven clips but exposed a mirrored validation start pair at 26143200 microradians per second squared against the frozen 25000000 limit. V11 at eighty passes corrected that pair but moved train nominal walk to 25444800 acceleration and validation left turn to 1008196 micrometres per second support-sole speed, so it also remains diagnostic-only. A bounded integer sweep from sixty-eight through seventy-six passes evaluated all three critical base clips through the complete local validator. Sixty-nine passes maximize the minimum normalized reserve: validation start acceleration is 24537600, validation left-turn support speed is 990949, and train nominal-walk acceleration is 21603600. The existing twenty-five-percent joint-velocity projection is unchanged. The heldout Sneaking crop is extended within the same immutable source file and split group from frame 1000 to frame 1400 so four full post-closure cycles remain observable. The exhaustive V12 horizon-eleven audit completed all 12368 phases but retained 3060 hard impacts. Exact phase-to-artifact analysis found 3019 of those impacts among the 12071 starts whose minimum collider height was exactly the prior 500-micrometre clearance; 91 percent of impact starts already declared the impacted sole as a reference contact. This profile therefore seats the already-declared contact on the exact ground plane at zero clearance while preserving the fail-closed minus-two-micrometre penetration check. The change targets only the diagnosed reference-reset contact gap and does not authorize an optimizer run. Fresh deterministic import, native pose, visual-overlay and exhaustive dynamic evidence remain mandatory before TRAIN-4 can advance.
